text: M23 rebels take about $800,000 a month in levies on coltan mining.
short: $800k a month in coltan levies taken by M23

text: More than 120 tonnes of coltan a month smuggled from Congo’s Rubaya mines into Rwanda since April 2024.
short: 120+ tonnes of coltan a month smuggled into Rwanda

text: Rubaya, in eastern Congo, produces about 15% of the world’s tantalum, a metal used in phones and laptops. M23 took control of the mines in 2024.
From Rwanda the coltan ships on to smelters in China, Kazakhstan and Thailand. Global Witness found it may have unwittingly reached global electronics brands.
Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024.
US intelligence assessed that the crown prince approved the 2018 operation that killed journalist Jamal Khashoggi.

source.name: US Office of the Director of National Intelligence

text: 43 activists and dissidents were given life sentences in a 2024 mass trial that rights groups called grossly unfair.
